name: pebbo-openai
description: Find and inspect public Pebbo marketplace listings and see who posted them, list a seller's other listings or a user's listings by @username, read your own listings and your liked listings, and with separate permission like listings or post, edit, mark sold and delete your own and hand you a link to add photos. Requires a Pebbo account.

interface.shortDescription: Find Pebbo listings and manage your own.
interface.longDescription: Search public Pebbo listings, inspect details and see who posted them, get a link to open an item, list a seller's other listings or a user's listings by @username, and read your own listings and your liked listings. The agent sees other people by display name and @username, never by their email. Sign in to your Pebbo account on first use. Liking and publishing each need their own approval; with publishing, the agent can post, edit, mark sold and delete your own listings and give you a link to add photos yourself. Messaging and purchases are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Show me details for this Pebbo listing.
